caption: The drawing depicts an elderly woman sitting on a chair that is covered with a deep red fabric featuring a black pattern. The woman is dressed in a long, light brown dress with patches on the elbows and a light-colored apron over her lap. Underneath her dress, a white petticoat and the hem of another garment are visible. She wears a grayish-white bonnet tied under her chin and a matching scarf draped around her shoulders. The woman appears to be holding a small object in her hands, possibly a piece of needlework or a small bouquet, with thin blue gloves covering her hands. The composition centers the figure and chair against a plain, beige background. The drawing uses mostly muted earth tones, with pale browns, grays, and subdued reds and greens. The artist's name, William Frank, is faintly visible below the image.
title: Nut Head Doll #2
